prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1407; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal on a commercial corridor in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle directly behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a speed consistent with the damage seen on both cars. Driver 2 stated that the brakes did not respond in time and that the impact was unavoidable. Two independent witnesses on the adjacent sidewalk gave statements matching this account, and photographs taken at the scene show the rear damage on Driver 1's vehicle and the front-end damage on Driver 2's vehicle in a pattern consistent with the reported impact. Driver 1 and Passenger were both in the vehicle at the time, and officers confirmed their presence at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and was transported for evaluation. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was noted during the inspection, and officers observed no signs of an earlier collision. Driver 1 is listed as a member of the policyholder's household.
